name: dsh-grantwrite-patch
description: Auto-repair the Windows sandbox ACL failure 'SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite' and retry the command invisibly. FFI patch by default (dsh-acl-sandbox-patch scheme) on DSH >= 0.1.7; the ACL-repair fallback additionally requires DSH >= 0.2.x (sandbox package assets) and fails closed otherwise.

scripts.test: node test/apply.test.ts && node test/index.test.ts && node test/strategy.test.ts && node test/size-probe.test.ts
